description: This file is a Twig extension that adds a function to load templates directly from strings. It defines a class StringLoaderExtension with a method to provide the 'template_from_string' Twig function, enabling dynamic template creation from string inputs.

classes.name: StringLoaderExtension
classes.description: A Twig extension class that provides functions for loading templates from strings.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array of Twig functions provided by this extension, including 'template_from_string'.

methods.name: templateFromString
methods.description: Static method that creates a Twig template from a string, utilizing the environment to do so.
